blindSummary:
The distinguishing evidence inside this macro-region is one dominant region's institutionalised official hostility. In 2014 its regional council approved a motion (14 October 2014) and the regional government followed with a resolution of 27 November 2014 - published in the region's official bulletin on 16 December 2014 - instituting an official 'natural family' feast day on the last school day before the winter break and formally rejecting the aims and content of the WHO regional office's sexuality-education standards, committing to counter their adoption in the region's schools. In July 2018 the council approved a motion pledging regional support for 'those who fight in defence of the natural family' and natalist policies, and dismissed Pride events as 'carnival farces'.

In 2025 a gay student was stalked by three self-described fascist men in the macro-region's most populous city. No violence-monitoring data names any region of this macro-region among the six highest-victim regions, and the two autonomous regions inside it have not used expanded legislative competence on gender matters. The natural-family acts and the WHO rejection are official acts of hostility and a clear climate signal to a visitor, but they do not criminalise, fine, or create enforcement exposure; the practical visitor risk from the policy layer is being unwelcome, not arrested.
blindSourceSummaries: LGBT association report (July 2018): on 3 July, in the 178th public session of the dominant region's council, a motion (first signer a regional councillor) was approved pledging regional support for 'those who fight in defence of the natural family' and for natalist policies, attacking the country's civil-unions law, and dismissing Pride marches as 'carnival farces'.

Official gazette record of the dominant region's government resolution of 27 November 2014 (published 16 December 2014): implementing the council motion of 14 October 2014, it institutes an official 'natural family' feast day on the last school day before the winter break and rejects the aims and content of the WHO regional office's sexuality-education standards, committing to counter their adoption in the region's schools (a named regional assessor drove the file).

LGBT news report (May 2025): three gay men were hospitalised after a homophobic beating by a group at an island-city fast-food restaurant around 5 a.m. on 26 April 2025, with homophobic insults, stools, helmets and blunt objects used, and a pepper-spray intervention ending the attack; the report also recalls the case of a gay student stalked by three self-described fascist men in the macro-region's most populous city - mob violence reaching both the mainland and the islands.
blindTangential: The documented street-level violence inside this macro-region has targeted gay men (the 2025 regional-capital stalking); no trans-specific violence pattern is named in the monitoring data for these regions.
blindLocalsOnly: The 'natural family' feast on the school calendar and the formal rejection of the WHO sexuality-education standards operate through regional schools and policy - residents and students meet them directly; a visitor meets them only as a climate signal.
